archetypes.name: auth-contract-drift
archetypes.rationale: Targets issue-specific risk that planned auth-mode assertions diverge from shared Codex auth helper behavior and launcher contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check whether the plan’s env-key, login-mode, stamp-isolation, sentinel-suppression, and temp-home cleanup claims match the actual launcher and shared auth-helper behavior. Compare the proposed new assertions against the existing fixtures and wrapper logs to find unreachable branches, wrong breadcrumbs, or assertions that would pass without proving the intended contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-topology
archetypes.rationale: Checks that the proposed test additions land in the right harness sections, Make targets, and scoped files without leaving coverage holes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that every planned test belongs in the stated harness, section, and CI shard, especially the review-and-fix dispatch section and the implementer temp-home coverage. Look for plan steps that target nonexistent helpers, omit required scope files, duplicate already-covered cases, or assume Makefile wiring that is not present. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
